text:
maria: Opening a small PR to refresh the hello-compact quickstart: add PKCE flow, short Python snippet, and replace cookie helper with 'decklink'. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4599. Need JS + Py snippet review, decklink checksum, and Linux smoke test.

tom: I'll take the JS review. Please include env vars example (REDWOOD_CLIENT_ID, AUTH_DOMAIN, DECKLINK_PATH) and a curl exchange example.

ivy: Add SDK compatibility note (>=0.9.0) and a migration one-liner for existing users of cookie-helper. Also add a short Dedicated/private callout to set AUTH_DOMAIN to the private endpoint.

ci-bot: CI: docs-build passed for PR #4599  preview: https://deploy-preview-4599--redwood-docs.netlify.app/hello-compact.html

qa-june: Running Ubuntu 22.04 smoke now. Steps?

maria: Steps: npm ci ; npm run dev ; ./decklink auth --client-id $REDWOOD_CLIENT_ID --redirect http://localhost:3000/callback ; curl -X POST https://auth.example.com/token -d 'grant_type=authorization_code&code=...&redirect_uri=http://localhost:3000/callback' ; open http://localhost:3000 and confirm greeting.

qa-june: Smoke done  decklink installs, token exchange succeeds, UI shows "Hello, QA". Left a tiny wording nit about redirect URIs.

maria: Thanks all 680 applied the wording nit and added checksum link. Merging after spellcheck. Will post a short note in #all-hands."
